limitations: This was a hash-bound method, record, and source rereview only. The reviewer did not rerun tests, GPU smoke, model forwards, grids, or reproduction commands, so the recorded post-repair executions were inspected but not independently reproduced.
Reviewer identity and independence are self-attested and are not authenticated by the packet runtime; use of a separate agent context does not establish organizational independence.
Matching SHA-256 values establish the exact current bytes reviewed, not that recorded commands, timestamps, environment values, or hardware identity are authentic or complete.

The initial review receipt preserves hashes and selected findings, but several initially reviewed mutable result files were superseded in place by post-repair reruns; this rereview evaluates the superseding bytes and cannot reconstruct every prior raw byte solely from this packet.

C-303 remains a descriptive result for one synthetic, one-graph, FP32 forward workload, one GPU/software state, one model seed, and one recorded input/topology seed. Timing is not bitwise deterministic, and the confirmed k=64 static advantage is only 2.7%.

The memory comparison remains peak allocated working-memory delta above a post-warmup live baseline plus prebuilt EGNN edge-index bytes. It excludes model parameters, common live inputs, CUDA reserved memory, graph construction, transfer, backward, gradients, and optimizer state and is not total end-to-end device memory.

The edge-free candidate and private EGNN execute different equations and do not receive matched topology. The candidate cannot distinguish arbitrary adjacency omitted from otherwise identical features and coordinates.
The initial grid preceded a disclosed spatial-only optimization, and k=80/k=96 remain post-outcome exploratory crossover-localization points rather than registered thresholds.

No historical production checkpoint, domain labels or splits, task accuracy, forces, chirality, molecular or protein transfer, point-cloud quality, compiled execution, multi-graph throughput, backward throughput, or production behavior was reviewed.
